candidates.headline: Bucs, DT Vita Vea agree to 1-year extension to end hold-in
candidates.description: Two-time Pro Bowl defensive tackle Vita Vea and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers have agreed on a one-year extension that guarantees him $30 million, sources told ESPN on Wednesday.

candidates.headline: Source: CB Trevon Diggs signing 1-year deal with Seahawks
candidates.description: Former Cowboys Pro Bowl cornerback Trevon Diggs plans to sign a one-year deal with the Seahawks, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Wednesday.

candidates.headline: Shedeur Sanders not feeling pressure about Browns' QB decision
candidates.description: With a decision at starting quarterback looming, Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders said Wednesday he's not feeling pressure ahead of joint practice with the Bills on Thursday and his start in the second preseason game at home Saturday.

candidates.headline: Sources: Texans' Jayden Higgins has torn ACL, out for season
candidates.description: Texans second-year wideout Jayden Higgins will miss the season after suffering a torn ACL during a joint practice with the Raiders, sources told NFL Network.
